programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Gubernatore Karolīna tiek nogalināta ballītē savas mājas dārzā. Šampanietis, ko viņai pasniedza pilnvarotais Selvins, bijis saindēts ar cianīdu. Aizdomās minēto sarakstā ir gan viņas kalpotāji, gan franču gubernators, kurš vēlas savā īpašumā iegūt mazu salu.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Modele Zoja tiek nožņaugta dažas minūtes pēc noiešanas no mēles. Visiem viņas kolēģiem, dizaineram, trīs modelēm un fotogrāfam ir neapšaubāmi alibi, jo aizkulises visu laiku tika apsargātas. Vienīgais pavediens - zeķe, kas sažņaugta upura plaukstā.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Dveina vecais sulainis Sedriks tiek atrasts miris. Kad viņš tiek kremēts, no upura telefona, kas ticis ielikts zārkā, Dveins saņem ziņu "Mani nogalināja". Pierādījumi liecina, ka viņš varētu būt noslepkavots, par aizdomās turamajiem padarot viņa trīs draugus un draudzeni.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Ciemos ierodas Gudmena tante Mērija, un jau pēc brīža viņa ir tūrista Džona Grīna vienīgā slepkavības lieciniece. Nelaimīgais ticis nogrūsts no sava balkona! Grīna pagātnes izpēte liecina, ka pirms pieciem gadiem šāda persona nav eksistējusi un pirmā lieta, ko viņš izdarījis, ierodoties šeit, ir tikšanās ar noziedznieku Nīlu Dženkinsu.

programme.title: Volejbols. Eiropas čempionāts vīriešiem
programme.desc: Iepriekšējā turnīrā cīņā par bronzu Francija zaudēja Slovēnijai ar 2 pret 3, kaut spēja atspēlēties pēc pirmajiem diviem zaudētajiem setiem, tomēr izšķirīgajā ar 15 pret 11 uzvarēja slovēņi. Mazajai Slovēnijai vispār mūsdienu sporta spēlēs daudzos veidos ir ļoti meistarīgas komandas – ne tikai volejbolā, bet arī basketbolā un handbolā. Starp citu, iepriekšējā finālturnīrā slovēņi ceturtdaļfinālā spēja uzvarēt Ukrainu, ko tolaik trenēja mūsu Uģis Krastiņš, tagadējais Latvijas izlases galvenais treneris. Šogad turnīrā spēlēs gana daudz līdzvērtīgu komandu, tāpēc nevar droši paredzēt, kas tiks līdz medaļu spēlēm, t. i., pusfināliem. Bez galvenajiem favorītiem Itālijas un Polijas vēl jāmin Francija, Slovēnija, Serbija un noteikti arī Nīderlande.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Gaetāns Filjons tiek arestēts par viltotas naudas glabāšanu un apriti. Lorāns ierodas pie Daniela, Stefans apgalvo, ka naudas viltošanas lieta pārvērtusies personiskā konfliktā starp Lorānu un Labellu. Briērs sava ziņojuma dēļ saņem draudus gan no Gaetāna, gan Daniela.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Gaetāns Filjons tiek nogalināts, Stefans arestē Fransuā Labellu. Ne Sonja, ne Gabriela neuzticas Veronikai Lenuārai Romano lietā. Stefans brīdina Briēru, ka "Sixers" var atriebties gan viņiem abiem, gan Lorānam. Nansijai tiek noteikts tuvošanās liegums Bruno, viņa izseko Bruno dzīvesbiedri Martinu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Martina ierodas iecirknī un pastāsta par tikšanos ar Nansiju. Nansija neliekas mierā un vēlāk zvana uz iecirkni, Bruno vairs nespēj to izturēt. Kāds vīrietis anonīmi nodod šifrētu informāciju Klāras slepkavības lietā, komanda cenšas to atšķetināt.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Klāras slepkavības lietā ar anonīmā ziņotāja palīdzību tiek atklāta jauna, šokējoša informācija, lieta paplašinās, nu tā ir saistīta ar nepilngadīgo pornogrāfiju un kļūst par iecirkņa prioritāti. Uz sarunu tiek uzaicināti viena iesaistītā jaunieša vecāki.

programme.title: Zaļā mušmire. Nāvējošās maltītes lieta
programme.desc: Trīsdaļīgā dokumentālā filma "Zaļā mušmire. Nāvējošās maltītes lieta" rekonstruē vienu no skaļākajām Austrālijas krimināllietām, kurā pēc ģimenes pusdienām trīs cilvēki mira no saindēšanās ar zaļajām mušmirēm. Filma seko notikumiem no traģēdijas brīža līdz sarežģītajam un plaši atspoguļotajam tiesas procesam. Žurnālistu, juristu un liecinieku balsīs atklājas gan pierādījumu ķēde, gan sabiedrības spriedumi. Centrā ir jautājums: nelaimes gadījums vai apzināts noziegums?

programme.title: Zinātnes noslēpumi
programme.desc: Dažādas mūsu ikdienā ierastas darbības un notikumi, izskaidroti no zinātnes viedokļa.

programme.title: Volejbols. Eiropas čempionāts vīriešiem
programme.desc: Arī pirms trim gadiem fināls notika Itālijā, Romā, un tajā mājinieki nedaudz negaidīti ar 0 pret 3 zaudēja Polijai. Setos gan bija gana spraigi, bet tomēr vienmēr galotnēs uzvarēja poļi. Šoreiz fināls notiks Milānā, lielajā "PalaItalia Santa Giulia" arēnā, ko uzcēla nesen, Milānas–Kortīnas ziemas olimpiskajām spēlēm (hokeja turnīram). Te ir vietas 16 tūkstošiem skatītāju, un tribīnēs būs varena atmosfēra, līdzīgi kā tas bija sieviešu finālturnīrā nesen Stambulā ar tikpat lielu arēnas ietilpību. Ja vēl Itālija jeb "Gli Azzurri" spēlēs finālā, atmosfēra tribīnēs tiešām būs vienreizēja. Itālijai septiņas reizes izdevies iegūt čempionu titulu Eiropā, tā ir pieckārtējā pasaules čempione, taču ne reizi nav ieguvusi olimpisko zeltu, kaut vairākkārt spēlējusi finālā. Izlase ir ļoti spēcīga, gandrīz visi spēlētāji nāk no stiprākajiem Itālijas klubiem, un šī līga faktiski ir labākā Eiropā un visā pasaulē.

programme.title: Viņpus paradīzei
programme.desc: Seriāls ir BBC veidota krimināldrāma, kas atvasināta no seriāla "Nāve paradīzē" sižeta līnijas. Stāsts vēsta par detektīvu inspektoru Hamfriju Gudmenu, kurš pametis Karību salu Sentmerī, lai būtu kopā ar Martu Loidu. Kad abi saderinājušies, viņi pārceļas uz Martas dzimto pilsētu Šiptonebotu, kas atrodas Devonā. Hamfrijs sāk darbu vietējā policijas iecirknī. Viņš spēj atstāt spilgtu iespaidu uz vietējiem policistiem: seržanti Esteri Viljamsu, konsteblu Kelbiju Hārtfordu un biroja vadītāju Margo Mārtinsu. Visi ir pārsteigti par jaunā detektīva darba metodēm, kuras izrādās visai iedarbīgas.

programme.title: Melnais saraksts
programme.desc: Kritiķu un skatītāju iemīļots kriminālseriāls. Tā darbība sākas dienā, kad darbu FIB galvenajā birojā Vašingtonā uzsāk jauna profilētāja Elizabete Kīna. Tajā pašā rītā tur ierodas viens no FIB meklētākajiem noziedzniekiem, Reimonds "Reds" Redingtons, un labprātīgi ļauj sevi notvert. Reds palīdz FIB sagūstīt citu bīstamu noziedznieku un novērst uzbrukumu civiliedzīvotājiem. Viņš paziņo, ka viņam esot vesels saraksts un informācija par tādiem noziedzniekiem un teroristiem, par kuru esamību FIB pat nenojauš. Reds ir gatavs sadarboties ar vienu savādu noteikumu – viņš runās tikai ar Elizabeti. Tā sākas īpašas attiecības, kuru īstā daba un iemesls ir zināmi tikai Redingtonam. Lai gan pamatā seriāla darbība norit ASV, tas aizved arī uz dažādām eksotiskām vietām visā pasaulē un ļauj ieskatīties kriminālajā pasaulē. Dažādiem apbalvojumiem vairāku gadu laikā izvirzīti seriāla specefektu veidotāji, kaskadieri un muzikālais noformējums.

programme.title: Pārtikas revidents
programme.desc: "Pārtikas revidents" ir analītisks raidījums, kas pēta veikalu plauktos un tirgū pieejamās pārtikas izcelsmi, saturu un cenu atšķirību, katrā raidījumā īpašu uzmanību veltot kādam produktam. Kas patiesībā ir šī produkta sastāvā? Kas ir izplatītākie mīti par to, un vai tie ir patiesi? Kur un kā šis pārtikas produkts tiek radīts? Vai cena vienmēr nozīmē kvalitāti? Šie ir tikai daži no jautājumiem, uz kuriem tiek meklētas atbildes. Raidījuma idejas autors ir žurnālists un raidījuma "Aizliegtais Paņēmiens" vadītājs Guntis Bojārs, vadītāja – Ieva Strazdiņa. Tā vienlaikus ir arī Ievas Strazdiņas debija LTV žurnālistu komandā. Raidījumā aktīvi darbosies arī žurnālistes Krista Tuča, Lauma Krastiņa un Liena Skadiņa.

programme.title: Vides fakti
programme.desc: Raidījums par norisēm dabā un apkārtējā vidē. "Vides fakti" sniedz informāciju par sezonālām norisēm dabā un dzīvnieku pasaulē, par vides aktualitātēm, par videi draudzīgu dzīvesveidu, par aktuālām cilvēka un vides attiecībām ārpus Latvijas robežām. Raidījumā "Vides fakti" ir skatāmi arī piedzīvojumu sižeti par aktīvā tūrisma iespējām Latvijā, kā arī īsfilmas par neparastiem ceļojumiem pasaulē.

programme.title: Kultūrdeva
programme.desc: "Kultūrdevā" viesojas māksliniece Ieva Jurjāne, kura šonedēļ kopā ar radošo grupu un režisoru Viesturu Kairišu nosvinējusi filmas "Uļa" pirmizrādi. Runāsim ne tikai par kino un teātra mākslinieka darba specifiku, bet arī par citām Ievas Jurjānes mākslinieciskajām interesēm. Raidījuma otrajā daļā viesojas aktrise Dana Avotiņa-Lāce un režisore Liena Šmukste. Kā izveidot izrādi pašiem mazākajiem skatītājiem, kas būtu saistoša arī viņu vecākiem?

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Emīls Lisovs - komandas kapteinis. Students no Tukuma, Rīgas Tehniskajā universitātē apgūst aviācijas transporta programmu. Spēlē sitaminstrumentus pūtēju orķestrī un dzied korī. Seko līdzi jaunākajiem atklājumiem zinātnē. Aktīvs lidmodeļu sporta fans. Apmeklē sporta zāli un izbauda brīvos mirkļus makšķerējot. Valdis Rihards Vorons - komandas kapteiņa draugs. Studē RTU ķīmijas tehnoloģijas specialitāti. Spēlē basketbolu, brauc ar velosipēdu. Interesē ģeogrāfija, fizika un arī matemātika. Patriks Vencels - baušķenieks, kurš šobrīd studē Rīgas Tehniskajā universitātē, aviācijas transporta programmu. Spēlē saksofonu pūtēju orķestrī. Regulāri apmeklē svaru zāli. Brīvajā laikā spēlē šahu sacensību līmenī. Renārs Davidonis - komandas kapteinis. Studējis ekonomiku, profesionāls hokeja tiesnesis, aizraujas ar šahu un hokeju. 2026. gadā tiesāja pasaules čempionātu hokejā Šveicē. Uzskata sevi par sportisku un jautru cilvēku. Spēcīgās puses ir arī ģeogrāfija, sports un vēsture. Lauris Zarāns - strādā IT un biznesa konsultāciju jomā. Brīvajā laikā aizraujas ar automobiļiem, ceļošanu un ēst gatavošanu. Spēcīgākās zināšanu jomas ir tehnoloģijas un ģeogrāfija, labi orientējas arī sportā un pasaules aktualitātēs. Ritvars Roberts Rudzītis - "mūžīgais" students, topošais inženieris un hokeja tiesnesis. Kaislīgs Latvijas dzelzceļa vēstures interesents un dzelzceļa modelists. Kādreiz mēdza papildināt Vikipēdiju. Spēcīgās puses: ģeogrāfija, Latvijas vēsture un politika.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: 1000 jūdzes Transilvānijā
programme.desc: Sudraba lodes, krusti pret vampīriem un saules baterija uz jumta. Tā bruņojušies, trīs vīri nē, nevis laivā, bet gan auto, devās piedzīvojumu ekspedīcijā 1000 jūdzes pa Transilvāniju.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: "Rīgas galvenā nomale" – tā savā grāmatā novadpētnieks Arvis Pope dēvēja zemi no Vakarbuļļiem līdz Bolderājai (Rīga, Zelta grauds, 2005). Vētījot "Ielas garumā" arhīvu, tam jāpiekrīt: šajā apkaimē 20 gados esam bijuši 10 reizes! Un jāatzīst, ka katrs nākamais raidījums bijis atklājums, jo tā ir apkaime, kura uzreiz vaļā neveras. Raidījuma jubilejas gadu noslēdzot, atkal tiksimies ar tēlnieku Paulu Jaunzemu viņa Skulptūru parkā un iegriezīsimies apkaimes centrālajā kultūrvietā – Bolderājas Mūzikas un mākslas skolā. Atklāsim arī jaunas adreses Lielajā un Stūrmaņu ielā.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Tavas apkārtnes stāsti.

programme.title: Tutas Lietas
programme.desc: Cik rokai ir pirkstu? Kā pagatavot kūku no smiltīm? Un kā skan bungas? Izzinot sevi un pasauli, bērniem ir daudz jautājumu. "Tutas lietas" ir video stāstu sērija bērniem vecumā no viena līdz pieciem gadiem, ko žurnāliste un raidījumu vadītāja Marta Selecka radījusi kopā ar domubiedriem – mazu bērnu vecākiem no kino un TV profesionāļu vides. Raidījuma būtība – tas ir mīļš un izglītojošs ekrāna saturs pašiem mazākajiem, viņiem saprotamā valodā par interesantām un noderīgām tēmām. Raidījuma galvenā varone ir jaukā meitene, bērnu draudzene Tuta. Viņas lomā iejutusies aktrise un mamma Liene Sebre. Tuta mazajiem jautru rotaļu veidā māca pašus pirmos vārdus, krāsas, dziesmiņas un skaitļus. Kopā ar Tutu jaunas lietas bērniem apgūt palīdz arī draudzīgā un ziņkārīgā Lapsa. "Tutas lietu" stāstiņu kopējo konceptu veidojusi Marta Selecka, bet scenārijus sagatavojusi jaunā, talantīgā bērnu autore Inga Mastiņa. Bērniem saistošu radošu vizuālo noskaņu radījusi pieredzējusī dizainere Ilze Žūriņa-Šeibaka, bet Tutas dziesmas mūzikas autore un izpildītāja ir dziedātāja un komponiste Laura Polence. Tutas piedzīvojumus iemūžinājis operators Dāvis Doršs, bet projekta režiju un montāžu veidojusi Andra Doršs, kura par savu darbu Latvijas kino projektos ieguvusi arī Nacionālo kino balvu "Lielais Kristaps".

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: Grūti pateikt, kā Andrim Kozulim no Tirzas puses līdz šim dzīvē ir bijis vairāk - nejaušību vai likumsakarību... Lai nu kā, padzīvojis pa Rīgu, uz kuģiem izgājis pasaules jūrās, viņš ir palicis uzticīgs dzimtajai pusei. Vēl kopš pagājušā gadsimta astoņdesmitajiem vietējie Andri atceras kā lustīgu muzikantu. Tolaik ar grupu tika nospēlētas neskaitāmas ballītes un kāzas tuvākā un tālākā apkārtnē. Tam ar laiku nākuši klāt neskaitāmi citi arodi. Un šodien bez dziedāšanas korī un teātra spēlēšanas Andris arī mūrē krāsnis un rāpjas tīrīt skursteņus. Bet viņa mīļā ģitāra nekur nav pazudusi.

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Gudrs, vēl gudrāks
programme.desc: Kompetenti eksperti katrā spēlē sagatavos atbilstošus jautājumus konkrētai vecuma grupai. Jautājumi ietvers mācību vielu un sabiedriski aktuālas tēmas mūzikā, mākslā, vēsturē, politikā un citās jomās. Savus jautājumus spēles dalībniekiem gan atraktīvā video formātā, gan tiešraidē studijā, sagatavo arī sabiedrībā zināmi cilvēki – kultūras jomas pārstāvji, zinātnieki, sportisti, politiķi, mūziķi un citi.

programme.title: Amatieris
programme.desc: Profesija ir kas vairāk par darbību un amata nosaukumu, zem tās ir personība. Šajās sērijās raidījuma vadītājs Reinis Ošenieks izmēģinās un kļūs par amatieri visdažādākajās nodarbēs. Sākot ar netradicionāliem hobijiem līdz profesijām, par kurām tiek runāts reti. Raidījuma vadītājam vienmēr būs kāds līdzgaitnieks, sabiedrībā zināms cilvēks, kurš kopā ar vadītāju centīsies dienas laikā kļūt no iesācēja par amatieri. Humors tiks sabalansēts ar informatīvām sadaļām un interesantām personībām. Intriga par izzināmo profesiju saglabāsies līdz pēdējam brīdim, jo raidījuma viesis nezinās, kas viņu dienas laikā sagaidīs.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Pirmās lēdijas
programme.desc: Ir 1961. gads. Amerika sveic jauno, valdzinošo prezidentu un pirmo lēdiju Baltajā namā. Iepriekšējam prezidentam Dvaitam Eizenhaueram bija 70 gadi, un nu ieradās Kenediji. Viņam bija 43, bet viņa kundzei – 31 gads. Amerikai ieejot jaunā laikmetā kopā ar paaudzi, kas gatava iekarot pasauli, Kenediji prata parādīt savu jaunību kā kaut ko dziļāku un simboliskāku.

programme.title: Nakts reiss
programme.desc: Londonas detektīve Hana Lī ir norīkota pavadīt doktoru Metjū Nolanu uz Pekinu, kur viņš tiek apsūdzēts smagā noziegumā. Taču 357. nakts reisā uz Ķīnu Hana saprot, ka šis uzdevums nebūt nebūs tik vienkāršs – lidojuma laikā viņa tiek ierauta sarežģītā sazvērestībā, kurā neko nevar uztvert par pašsaprotamu. Nolans apgalvo, ka ir nevainīgs, bet Hana apšauba visu, ko līdz šim zinājusi, un to, kas ir viņas patiesie sabiedrotie. Nezināmi ienaidnieki vēlas panākt, lai Nolans nekad nesasniegtu galamērķi, bet Hana kļūst par mērķi tiem, kuri vēlas noslēpt patiesību par Nolana pagātni. Spriedzei pieaugot, lidmašīnā parādās pirmās slepkavības, un Hana saprot, ka atklājumi, kas viņu sagaida, var maksāt gan viņas, gan Nolana dzīvību.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Gaetāns Filjons tiek arestēts par viltotas naudas glabāšanu un apriti. Lorāns ierodas pie Daniela, Stefans apgalvo, ka naudas viltošanas lieta pārvērtusies personiskā konfliktā starp Lorānu un Labellu. Briērs sava ziņojuma dēļ saņem draudus gan no Gaetāna, gan Daniela.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Gaetāns Filjons tiek nogalināts, Stefans arestē Fransuā Labellu. Ne Sonja, ne Gabriela neuzticas Veronikai Lenuārai Romano lietā. Stefans brīdina Briēru, ka "Sixers" var atriebties gan viņiem abiem, gan Lorānam. Nansijai tiek noteikts tuvošanās liegums Bruno, viņa izseko Bruno dzīvesbiedri Martinu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Martina ierodas iecirknī un pastāsta par tikšanos ar Nansiju. Nansija neliekas mierā un vēlāk zvana uz iecirkni, Bruno vairs nespēj to izturēt. Kāds vīrietis anonīmi nodod šifrētu informāciju Klāras slepkavības lietā, komanda cenšas to atšķetināt.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Klāras slepkavības lietā ar anonīmā ziņotāja palīdzību tiek atklāta jauna, šokējoša informācija, lieta paplašinās, nu tā ir saistīta ar nepilngadīgo pornogrāfiju un kļūst par iecirkņa prioritāti. Uz sarunu tiek uzaicināti viena iesaistītā jaunieša vecāki.

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Emīls Lisovs - komandas kapteinis. Students no Tukuma, Rīgas Tehniskajā universitātē apgūst aviācijas transporta programmu. Spēlē sitaminstrumentus pūtēju orķestrī un dzied korī. Seko līdzi jaunākajiem atklājumiem zinātnē. Aktīvs lidmodeļu sporta fans. Apmeklē sporta zāli un izbauda brīvos mirkļus makšķerējot. Valdis Rihards Vorons - komandas kapteiņa draugs. Studē RTU ķīmijas tehnoloģijas specialitāti. Spēlē basketbolu, brauc ar velosipēdu. Interesē ģeogrāfija, fizika un arī matemātika. Patriks Vencels - baušķenieks, kurš šobrīd studē Rīgas Tehniskajā universitātē, aviācijas transporta programmu. Spēlē saksofonu pūtēju orķestrī. Regulāri apmeklē svaru zāli. Brīvajā laikā spēlē šahu sacensību līmenī. Renārs Davidonis - komandas kapteinis. Studējis ekonomiku, profesionāls hokeja tiesnesis, aizraujas ar šahu un hokeju. 2026. gadā tiesāja pasaules čempionātu hokejā Šveicē. Uzskata sevi par sportisku un jautru cilvēku. Spēcīgās puses ir arī ģeogrāfija, sports un vēsture. Lauris Zarāns - strādā IT un biznesa konsultāciju jomā. Brīvajā laikā aizraujas ar automobiļiem, ceļošanu un ēst gatavošanu. Spēcīgākās zināšanu jomas ir tehnoloģijas un ģeogrāfija, labi orientējas arī sportā un pasaules aktualitātēs. Ritvars Roberts Rudzītis - "mūžīgais" students, topošais inženieris un hokeja tiesnesis. Kaislīgs Latvijas dzelzceļa vēstures interesents un dzelzceļa modelists. Kādreiz mēdza papildināt Vikipēdiju. Spēcīgās puses: ģeogrāfija, Latvijas vēsture un politika.

programme.desc: Latvijas Sirdsdziesma ir sirsnīgi muzikāls raidījums, kurā tiek atspoguļotas tautā vispopulārākās latviešu mūzikas dzīves norises šī vārda visplašākajā nozīmē.

programme.title: America's Deadliest Volcano Disaster
programme.desc: Forty years ago, on May 18, 1980, Mount St. Helens erupted violently. It was the most deadly and devastating eruption in U.S. history. Combining eyewitness accounts with rarely seen images, this show reveals the unfolding apocalypse; from the first moments of the volcanic blast, to a 12-mile high ash plume and the lethal mudflows that raged down the mountain.

programme.title: The Next Mega Tsunami
programme.desc: Ten years after one of the most deadly tsunamis ever known, scientists are making a shocking discovery. Experts used to believe that the biggest killer waves were only generated in a handful of regions.

programme.title: Inside The Mega Twister
programme.desc: The tornado that struck El Reno, Oklahoma, on May 31st, 2013, defied superlatives. It was the largest, one of the fastest, and for storm chasers the most lethal twister ever recorded on Earth. In a unique documentary, professionals and witnesses unravel the tornado and tell its story. This is no typical storm-chasing documentary. Among those whose lives it claimed was Tim Samaras, revered as one of the most experienced and cautious scientists studying tornadoes. This storm, however was unlike any he had witnessed before. The storm was also probably the best documented in history. In the wake of the tragedy, Dr Anton Seimon gathered all the video footage available of the storm and organised it into a searchable database. He pinpointed the exact location of every camera pointing at the storm, and used lightning patterns to synchronise every frame of video down to the second. Combined with many first-hand accounts and harrowing videos from scientists and amateur storm chasers, and accompanied by some state-of-the-art CGI animations, the result is an extraordinary and unprecedented journey through the heart of the storm.

programme.title: Witness to Disaster
programme.desc: The tornado super outbreak in April 2011 is unprecedented; over just 4 days, 360 tornadoes leave a trail of devastation as deadly weather systems build along the southern states of the USA. One of the deadliest tornadoes touches down in Alabama, and destroys two towns in 15 minutes. By 28th April, 348 people have been killed, thousands are homeless and the overall damage is in excess of 12 billion dollars.

programme.title: Witness to Disaster
programme.desc: Eyewitness; compelling stories of disaster, told through the eyes of those who were there. A Mine Collapses in Chile, Wildfires burn in Portugal, A Debris Flow crushes a Californian town, Tornadoes rampage across the US, a Ship Sinks in a Hurricane and an Earthquake brings destruction to Nepal. Through forensic analysis, we reveal how these events unfolded and how split-seconds decisions make the difference between life and death.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In the stunning frozen landscape of the Arctic Circle, David Blaine explores humanity's curiously extreme ability to endure freezing temperatures. He meets and learns from people who reach beyond their limits to transform barriers into new frontiers and embody a sense of resilience, perseverance and grit that is unique to the region.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Explorer Hazen Audel faces impenetrable rainforest as he begins a 500-mile survival challenge. In this first leg of his journey, he must escape to the edge of the forest before being trapped by the floods of the rainy season. With the help of the forest's Wai Wai people, Hazen takes on lethal snakes, makes poisoned darts, and endures an agonising jungle ritual.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel attempts to cross the open savannah in the second leg of his 500-mile Amazon challenge. He joins the native Wapishana cowboys in a desperate cattle-drive north, tackling giant anaconda, venomous rattlesnakes, and a treacherous river crossing as they attempt to escape the coming floods.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel tackles the soaring Kanuku Mountain forests in the third leg of his 500-mile Amazon challenge. Using the survival skills of the local mountain people, he traps electric eels, climbs a sheer mountain peak, and hacks through an impenetrable forest of bamboo to reach the far side of the mountains before floods and landslides block his path.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel faces thundering waterfalls as he enters gorge country, in the fourth leg of his 500-mile Amazon challenge. Against faeces-squirting spiders, and the world's most dangerous snake, he relies on the traditional skills of the fierce Arekuna people to survive, learns to hunt with a blow-pipe and rides the wild water of the regions rapids.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel faces the final ordeal in his 500-mile Amazon challenge, crossing miles of snake-filled mangrove swamp to reach the Atlantic Ocean. With the help of the local Warau people, he learns how to live on water and braves killer bees in a daring night raid, before attempting to deliver a prestigious catch to the Amazon's most northerly people.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on a 1989 VW Golf GTi, one of the most iconic cars to have come out of the 1980s and one which just happens to be Tim Shaw's all-time favourite car. The boys challenge this time is to make this particular Golf suitable for its owner Darren, a former bus driver who was left disabled and partially sighted after a tragic road accident in which he saved the life of his young grandson.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Today Tim and Fuzz are off to West Sussex to rescue an iconic 1970s motor - the first truly successful Japanese car export - the mighty Datsun 240z. Retired GP Paul has owned and loved his car since it was virtually new however when the car started needing too much work it ended up in Paul's garage rotting away while he put his work in the community first . Paul's family wrote in to Car SOS in the hope Tim and Fuzz would be able to repay their Dad for the years of help he has brought to others by fully restoring his beloved car. However what at first looks like a bit of a breeze for the boys turns into a right old rust storm. Will they get the car back to Paul in time ?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: In the late 1960s BMW were looking to break into the US market and the sports saloon they created to make the right waves was the 2002, a 2 litre, 100bhp tourer, it instantly became a successful race car with Hans Stuck winning the Nurburgring 24-hour race in 1970. As a result the 2002 arrived in the states in 1967 to instant success and rapid and highly profitable sales. BMW didn't rest on its laurels, in 1973 they started producing a fuel injected turbo version of the 2002 : the tii. Launched at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show it was BMW's, and Europe's, first turbocharged production car, it produced 170 bhp and had a top speed of 115mph and where its predecessor had been a success on the track the tii continued on the World rally Circuit where it went on to win many rallies and hill climbs. In actuality only 1,672 Turbos were ever built, but they achieved BMWs aim of making them a World renowned brand name in a few short years and salvaging the tatters or the BMW distribution network in the US. With its striking "shark nose" front end the 2002 set the style that BMWs were to follow to this day. Very few 2002tiis now exist making them not just a fun car to drive but also a sure fire commodity on the classics market.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim & Fuzz head to Cambridge to rescue a big cuddly and cherished Range Rover. The Range Rover represented a huge change of gear for Land rover in 1970 when it was introduced. A big, comfortable car that was as smooth as a big saloon but could easily keep up with a Land Rover across a muddy field. The later 1991 Range Rover Vogue that Tim & Fuzz collect symbolized freedom and happy days for Margaret, her husband and their family. Used to tow their caravan all over the UK, this 4 wheel drive was always dependable that durable. Now a sad reminder of better times, the car is in desperate need of some TLC; Enter CarSOS. Fuzz stresses when he realizes the whole car is tired, rusty and likely to be a world of parts finding pain. For Tim it's a challenge he cant resist, coming up with the blag of his life to make this big project possible. The biggest challenge of all though is making the car accessible for Margaret who, with her disability getting worse, has started to really struggle to climb on board the tall car. Fuzz and Tim decide the way forward is to fit a whole new adjustable air suspension system. Finding a way to fit that in among the crowded body shell as well as overhauling tired major components such as both front and rear axles, keeps Fuzz flat out for days. Tim meanwhile sets out to find out how to make the best veneer in the country. All this, plus replacement parts in every other nook and cranny of this complex car, plus the usual spectacular paint job, result in a massive transformation. But will Margaret think a showroom rebirth is the right thing to do to her beloved car, and what has Fuzz been up to?

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: In the vast grassy plains of Mongolia, Eva zu Beck sets out to become a modern-day warrior. Guided by a female horseback archery champion, she learns the fundamentals of archery and how to combine those skills with hands-free horseback riding. Along the way, she connects with local communities and gains a deeper understanding of one of the world's best-preserved ancient cultures. From the sweeping landscape to the strength of tradition, Eva is struck by the beauty of these rural Mongolian hills and the people's unwavering commitment to preserving their heritage.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Eva zu Beck meets a group of Indigenous women in Bolivia known as the "Climbing Cholitas," who are on a mission to reclaim their power and redefine their place in a conservative society. One climb at a time, they endure tough routes at extreme altitudes, all while wearing traditional pollera skirts as an act of resistance. Eva joins them on a trek through the Condoriri Glacier, hoping to harness their confidence and overcome her fear of heights. Ice pick and crampon in hand, she's able to walk and talk with the women to understand the level of strength and bravery they embody and how, ultimately, those traits are their superskill. With girl power all around her, Eva finds the courage to defy the odds of gravity, unlike ever before.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. A woman carrying cocaine in her body may have an accomplice. It's up to police to track her down before she can leave the country. Officers get word of a cocaine shipment and set up sting. An elderly woman seems surprised when police find cocaine in her bag. Could she be in on the scheme? A children's suit is soaked in cocaine.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: The oldest and youngest carriers from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A woman with cocaine and a record. 19-year-old student carries to help his sick mother. A 19-year-old woman claims her aunt tricked her. An old man cannot believe he is carrying, and neither can the relative he calls. An old man from the Marshall Islands may be part of a trend to enlist the elderly as carriers. A young Venezuelan man risks it all due to conditions at home.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: These carriers are frequent flyers. From Airport Security Colombia and Peru, a Spaniard with cocaine pretends to be shocked. A man going to the DR with cocaine tells officers he has been there before. A man on his second trip claims he was forced. A woman uses someone else's authentic passport to travel. An Indonesian woman carries cocaine and multiple types of currency. A freelance trafficker boasts he has information on a 1000 kilo load.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The worst aviation disaster in Florida's history occurred on May 11, 1996. ValuJet Flight 592 mysteriously crashed into the alligator-infested swamps of the Everglades, killing all 110 aboard. Had the FAA implemented safety regulations instated after a similar crash eight years earlier, the tragedy would never have happened. Follow the investigation that would outrage a nation, cost the Secretary of Transportation and an FAA administrator their jobs, and ultimately doom ValuJet Airlines.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. Why did the 100,000 tonne container ship MV Dali lose control in Baltimore harbour and hit the Francis Scott Key Road Bridge? And why was the bridge so vulnerable to a collision? What went wrong on board LOT flight 007 over Warsaw, Poland, that made it fall out of the sky? Pilot error? Mechanical failure? How did it manage to miss a building full of young people as it plunged to the ground? What caused the leak of a lethal chemical from the pesticide plant at Bhopal in Northern India? Why was it so deadly? Why didn't safety systems protect the victims?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: In northern Chile, 33 miners were buried more than half a mile deep in the desert with no way to escape. Across a terrifying first 17 days, the men must overcome impossible conditions to stay alive. As each passing day makes survival seem less likely, desperation sets in until an extraordinary discovery changes everything.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: Rescuers establish contact with the miners, sparking hope. Supplies make it underground, alleviating the terror of being trapped without food or water. As the world watches, the rescue team races to find a way through solid rock, but every possible solution brings new risks. Then, the ingenuity and determination of this unprecedented rescue effort are threatened by a devastating mechanical failure.

programme.title: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
programme.desc: The miners enter their second month underground, and the focus on the surface shifts to the seemingly impossible task of bringing all 33 men safely home. The rescue enters a critical phase as the miners prepare to enter a tiny capsule designed to transport them, one by one, through a treacherous borehole to the surface.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: For ages, prophets have suggested that disastrous eventsand maybe even the end of the worldlie ahead. Experts say there is no such thing as the power of foresight and that the predictions are broadly interpreted in order to keep the myth of prophetic ability alive. Are we looking at an unquenchable human desire to make sense out of the chaos of life - or a true Paranatural power?

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: After claiming to have received an ordained mission from Jesus Christ, Sun Myung Moon challenged traditional religious orthodoxy and established the Unification Church, a global movement that captivated millions. But, as the Church grew, so too did the accusations. Who was this godsend, and what were his motives? After Irene Hughes accurately predicts the assassination of JFK, the devastating 1967 Chicago blizzard and the murder of a wealthy heiress, she is given the distinction of America's Most Accurate Psychic. After disregarding the prophetic pronouncements of Rome's sacred chickens, Gen. Publius Claudius Pulcher meets his doom. It is a stark reminder of the consequences of defying the will of the gods.

An ancient Chinese text known as the "I Ching" offers profound musings on the complexities of life and the interconnectedness of all things. Those in power search for meaningful insights within its pages. Its words influenced the rise and fall of dynasties. The birth of a rare white buffalo, an event steeped in Native American meaning, is believed to herald significant change and spiritual awakening. Do these births reveal something hidden about the fabric of reality?

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: Drugs, Inc. delves inside the Los Angeles porn industry. The porn industry and drugs have a reputation for going hand in hand. But after HIV scares, porn sets are under more scrutiny than ever, and it's changing the way drugs on set are tolerated. This show features Ron Jeremy, Kacey Jordan (who survived Charlie Sheen's meltdown), meth addict Amanda Blow, and the former "world's hottest porn star" Brittni Ruiz.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: It's Spring Break and among thousands of US students who head to Cancun, Mexico there are some who have one thing on their mind: to get wasted. Two cartels - Sinaloa and Gulf - monopolize the tourist drug trade. But independent dealers - known as "hoppers" - are trying to poach their turf. Police meanwhile struggle to hold the line trying to head off the brewing violence and save gringo tourists from the consequences of their own folly.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel faces thundering waterfalls as he enters gorge country, in the fourth leg of his 500-mile Amazon challenge. Against faeces-squirting spiders, and the world's most dangerous snake, he relies on the traditional skills of the fierce Arekuna people to survive, learns to hunt with a blow-pipe and rides the wild water of the regions rapids.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Escape the Amazon
programme.desc: Survivalist Hazen Audel faces the final ordeal in his 500-mile Amazon challenge, crossing miles of snake-filled mangrove swamp to reach the Atlantic Ocean. With the help of the local Warau people, he learns how to live on water and braves killer bees in a daring night raid, before attempting to deliver a prestigious catch to the Amazon's most northerly people.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode we arrive in the holy city of Jerusalem to explore what we call the "God Brain." Billions of people around the world believe in a divine being, but how does the "believing brain" work? Is spirituality hardwired or installed in us by a divine Programmer, or is it part of a complex evolutionary adaptation process that has been transpiring for millions of years? This episode is an exciting opportunity to exploit hidden-camera experiments, man-on-the-street encounters, and high-tech laboratories across the globe in the quest to explore the neuro-physiology behind spiritual practice. The games devised in this episode will shed light on our perception of morality, faith, and the supernatural.You will learn that even those who don't practice religion feel an instinctual desire to believe, a desire that Dean Hamer from the National Institute of Heath calls "the God gene." Play along as we engage in brain games that suggest you do believe even if you think you dont!

programme.title: Supercar Megabuild
programme.desc: On this episode of Supercar MegaBuild, expert mechanics Shane and Dan have one of their toughest assignments yet. They need to try to convert an Audi R8 into a Gymkhana Grid contender. That means taking an exclusive, executive supercar and turning it into mean machine that can slip and slide its way around a car assault course. Time is tight and the pressure is cranked to the max. Have the guys bitten off more than they can chew?

programme.title: Supercar Megabuild
programme.desc: On this episode of Supercar MegaBuild, Jodie Kidd has an unusual request. She wants mechanics Shane and Dan to convert a family saloon Maserati Ghibli into something capable of going 200 miles an hour! That's a big ask since its original top speed is just 150. In addition, Jodie also wants it to have a retro restyle to embrace the appearance of the legendary Maserati Tepo from the 1960s. With a supercar for a supermodel, the pressure is on!

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. Why does the Greek ferry MV Samina drift so far off course that it collides with a well marked rock just minutes from its final destination? Why does it sink in less than an hour? Was a massive explosion in AZF in Toulouse, a French fertiliser factory caused by terrorism, chemical contamination or damp weather? Why did it devastate an entire suburb? What triggered the sudden collapse of a 40-year-old road bridge? Was it a design flaw? Corrosive chemicals? Or overloading?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real world disasters forensically analysed and dissected in astonishing detail using 3D graphics, expert analysis and all available evidence. How could a high rise fire in modern Madrid get so out of control that the entire building had to be demolished? How did the fire start? Why did it consume the building so rapidly? Why did the top floors collapse? Why did a garment factory in Bangladesh collapse so completely when it was packed with people? Could a power cut have triggered the deadliest accidental building collapse in history? Why did Reactor 4 at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in Ukraine explode? Was the worst nuclear accident in history caused by a safety test designed to prevent a nuclear accident?

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley immerses himself in the myths and mysteries of this wild island, discovering a cuisine that's as unique as its geography. He travels into the hills to reveal the secrets of longevity, shares a seaside pasta meal with royalty, cooks a pig underground, and learns how a much-loved recipe has its roots in ancient "fairy caves."

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley digs into the time-honored recipes of this famous region and discovers how these dishes are being kept alive and reinvigorated for the future. He goes behind bars to meet lawbreakers making high-end cakes, takes Sunday lunch with a Nigerian-born local chef who is renowned for making some of the region's most protected recipes, and wades into the controversy over the origins of tiramisu.

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley revels in the culinary artistry of this picturesque region. The spirit of creativity is alive in the birthplace of the Renaissance. In Florence, where he spent a memorable year of his youth, he samples a famous—yet unexpected—breakfast dish. He heads out on the ranch with traditional Tuscan cowboys and experiences a grand outdoor feast in Siena at the world-famous Palio.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: August 6, 1997. Korean Air Flight 801 is flying to Guam International Airport from Seoul, when it runs into bad weather. Turbulence bounces passengers and crew but much worse is to come. Fighting rain and inoperative navigational equipment, the crew struggle to find the airport. But just as they see the lights of Guam, the rain closes in again. As the plane flies closer and closer to the ground, warning sirens fill the cockpit. But still the crew, hampered by clouds and pelting rain, is flying blind. Flight 801 crashes five kilometres short of Agana airport, scattered down Nimitz Hill. While many passengers survive the crash, they cant escape the fires that tear through the wreckage. More than 200 people are killed. For one of the survivors Barry Small the crash is the beginning of a crusade to make air travel safer. He believes poor seat design broke the legs of many on board, making it impossible for them to escape. He also believes badly stored duty free liquor ignited after the crash, making the fires worse. For investigators, flight 801 is a wake-up call. Vital safety equipment that could have saved the plane had been disabled, and the crew was poorly trained for such difficult landings. In the months that followed, changes were made at the airport and to the training of Korean pilots.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Fifty-three human remains with gunshot wounds are unearthed on an uninhabited island in Croatia. Six mysterious flying objects are spotted above Puget Sound. On the Isle of Wight, paleontologists discover the fossilized remains of a previously unknown species of dinosaur. Strange ritual artifacts uncovered in Sweden signify the religious role of the island in medieval and ancient times.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Enormous ancient terraces made of volcanic rocks in West Java, Indonesia, have origins shrouded in mystery. Mysterious penguin remains are discovered in a place beyond the reach of these short-legged creatures.

programme.desc: Who fatally shot Italian Fascist dictator Benito Mussolini, without trial, after his capture by partisans, and why? What happened to the 'treasure' he carried with him, or was that the motive, perhaps documents that could discredit Churchill? - Was the most famous highwayman in Cromwell's republic executed as a traitor just for robbing notably parliamentarians, or executed for stubbornly proclaiming to remain an royalist, or did the Lord Protector carry a personal grudge beyond law? - Who laid the bomb that nearly blow up Napoleon Bonaparte, then Fisrt Consul, in his coach, and why? Did his security minister Fouché play a two-faced part?

In 2001, a blood-red rain falls over Kerala, inciting fears, superstitions and predictions of an imminent apocalypse. But Kerala is not the first city to experience this macabre downpour. And in ancient Greece, the oracle of Apollo at Didyma prophesied that Alexander the Great would invade and conquer the hulking Persian Empire, changing the course of history fore

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 17th-century Sicily, a devoted nun believed she was channeling a dark spirit when she penned a cryptic letter in garbled language. For centuries, the Church guarded the secrets of the damned dispatch, unable to crack its code. In 2017, the startling message was finally deciphered. In ancient Greece, a cult dedicated to the god of healing promised cures and prophetic visions. Pilgrims traveled from far and wide for miraculous medical interventions — and strange visions during sleep. And in Ireland, as warriors like the legendary Cúchulainn prepared for battle, they were believed to be visited by the Morrigan — an archaic goddess of war and fate, whose shape-shifting presence was seen as a sign of glorious victory or disastrous defeat.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Abandoned structures and machinery on an island near Antarctica point to brief human settlements. Disturbing noises heard by foreign diplomats in Cuba set off research on a possible global psychological phenomenon. Mysterious rubber-like slabs from Indonesia appear on European beaches. A strange stone pattern found in the waters of Florida's Dry Tortugas National Park reveals a long-lost island.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: An abandoned Cold War-era Russian military base is explored, and a palatial mansion is found decaying on Isla Grande off the Colombian coast. In the waters off of Japan's Yonaguni Island, a stone structure is discovered on the seafloor. Evidence of a turbulent past is unearthed on Italy's volcanic Stromboli Island.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Chess-playing computers are nothing new today, but how did a robot beat the world's best chess players back in 1770? Is this the world's first artificial intelligence, or is there sleight of hand at play? Charles Lindbergh was arguably the world's most famous man in the 1930s, as the first to fly non-stop across the Atlantic and then have his son tragically kidnapped. Lesser known is his invention of a singular glass pump of elegant design. What is it for? A 2,400-year-old mummy is brought from Egypt to Croatia by a collector. Only after it is donated to a museum does anyone realize that this mummy is wrapped in the rarest remnant of a lost language. The writing on the wrappings is pored over by experts to decipher it. What does it say?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: In 1995, a bone of an extinct bear is found in a Slovenian cave that could rewrite our place in the story of evolution. The bone appears to be carved with intention by someone at least 10,000 years before humans arrived in that part of the world. Who made it and why? A simple black dress shoe sits in a glass case in the Heinz Nixdorf Museums Forum in Germany. The reason? More than just a shoe, this is a high-tech machine for its time, designed to do the impossible: beat the casino. And an intricate purple gemstone adorned with silver snakes, quartz scarabs and cryptic words, has a long history intertwined with illness, ruin, tragedy and death. Where did it originate, and could it really be cursed?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: In 1898, a stunning object shows up at the British Museum. Carved and polished from a single piece of quartz, it is shaped like an immaculate human skull. Is this a creation of Mesoamericans, as originally claimed? Why is it rumoured to possess supernatural power? A gruesome-looking chair from ancient China, housed at the Wellcome Collection in London, is covered in sword blades, spikes and ornate decorations. Clearly, this is no love seat. Is it some kind of torture device, or more than meets the eye? From a long-buried library in the lost Assyrian city of Nineveh comes a peculiar round tablet scribbled with cuneiform writing. Is it the work of astronomers, proof of an ancient apocalypse, or a 3,000-year-old instruction manual?

programme.desc: Nikola, a farmer grappling with the harsh reality of new economic policies, is unable to sell his land or crops. When his family leaves in search of a better life abroad, he takes a job as a landfill attendant, where he encounters the injured white stork Silyan. As Nikola nurses the bird back to health, an unlikely bond forms between man and animal.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee. Lost and alone, Kio's chances of survival are slim, but he finds the courage to call out and reunites with his brothers. Together, they face a series of trials, from buffalo hunts to clashes with rival males, forging an unbreakable bond. Finally, as a confident male lion, almost fully grown, Kio returns to the marshland to face the old kings. Victory will secure a kingdom, a pride and a new family. Defeat means exile. Will Kio fall, or rise and finally claim his place as king?

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Survival is a daunting proposition. But when the going gets tough, the wild inhabitants morph into oddballs. Millennia of weird evolution have made this giant continent a land of mutants. Expect the unexpected because here, outlandish is the new normal.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how cheetah hunt lechwe, impala and wildebeest, offering new perspectives on the way these predators stalk, chase and kill using an innovative new 3D-graphics game engine to freeze and manipulate key instants to reveal 'moment by moment' the predatory features that are essential to survival within the cheetahs' world as they take on their adversaries. Here an experienced single mother faces the challenge of operating alone, protecting her young while maintaining a prolific and ruthless hunt strategy in order to keep her energy levels vitally topped up and a newly formed male coalition work together to take down a wildebeest in the ultimate battle of predator versus prey.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how crocodiles target their prey, offering new perspectives on the way they use their ambush strategies and physiological attributes to their advantage. Using an innovative new 3Dgraphics game engine to freeze and manipulate key instants, we reveal 'moment by moment' the predatory features that are essential to survival within the crocodiles' world. The narrative follows a dominant male as he tries to profit from the annual crossing of migratory herds of wildebeest and zebra, while smaller males try to prove their worth within the crocodile hierarchy and the females go on the hunt for a mate.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how polar bears hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics they use to track, stalk and ambush seals, whales and walruses. We follow a mother fighting to feed her two cubs in the harsh polar extremes, and a young male driven by starvation to tackle enormous prey.

programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Lion

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: In spring, the Carpathian Mountains' rarest forms of life burst free from the harshness of winter, beginning with an extraordinary moment when a mother bear emerges from hibernation. Her three tiny, yet adorable, cubs experience the world for the first time, following her across sheer cliffs in search of food. Meanwhile, in Slovakia's Tatra Mountains, a rare male capercaillie bird performs an elaborate mating ritual. In Ukraine, Ural owls are on the hunt to feed their chicks, while newly born chamois kids leap down precipitous snowfields, cheating death as they evade the soaring eagles above. The key to it all — the ancient trees themselves — provides not only a sanctuary but also the very beginnings of life itself, through their superpower of "eating the sun" and passing energy up the food chain in this vast, interconnected web of life.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour. Crossbills have hooked beaks to pluck seeds from spruce cones. As for the rare capercaillie, they digest pine needles by eating stones that grind the needles up in their digestive system. Despite the challenging but seasonal weather conditions, winter is mating season for the Carpathian's most elusive inhabitant and rarest animal: the lynx. Almost extinct in the rest of Europe, the vast wilderness of the Carpathians helps the species survive and thrive.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Compilation

Pula must protect and train Motshidi to take her rightful place in the kingdom as Pula's health weakens.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: In an action packed episode of Animal Fight Club we reveal what happens when the Animal Kingdom's most vicious species fight tooth and claw in the deadliest of conflicts. With exclusive user generated content and footage from top wildlife filmmakers, this episode sheds new light on the fiercest fights Mother Nature has to offer, proving that it's not always the animal you expect that ends up coming out on top …

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Dust
programme.desc: In Botswana, where the Okavango Delta fades into the Kalahari, water and desert clash in a yearly cycle of abundance and loss. Along Africa's longest zebra migration, herds, predators and desert survivors depend on the fleeting lifeline of the Boteti River. Elephants, lions and hyenas converge as shrinking water forces dangerous encounters, while thousands of zebras must choose between starvation and a perilous journey to the Makgadikgadi salt pans. When rains arrive, the desert briefly transforms, flamingos flood the pans and life surges, before heat returns and the cycle begins again. Combining cinematic spectacle with intimate storytelling, "Dust" explores resilience, climate and survival in a rapidly changing world.

programme.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Lions assert their dominance with ruthless precision, overpowering a hyena with ease. But not every predator submits. Wild dogs return to challenge the balance of power, and when a leopard mother stands her ground against a lion to defend her cubs, survival becomes fierce, raw and unforgiving in the fight to rule the wild.

programme.desc: Barbabērniem patīk nakts pasaciņas, bet ne tad, ja tās visu laiku atkārtojas. Barbabella pavada nemierīgu nakti kukaiņu dēļ.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo, Barbabella un Barbagudrais uzbūvē māju kokā. Barbamamma ir apņēmusies novērst piesārņojumu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbalala saņem paciņu ar rozā zvēriņiem, ko nosauc par Skvīkijiem. Barbabravo, Barbalala un Barbabo ir apnicis, ka brāļi un māsas par viņiem smejas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz tantei Celtnei, kas izaicina Ātrmeistaru noskaidrot, kurš ir ātrākais braucējs Celtnieklīcī. Kad ērglis Vingsija nespēj pacelties gaisā, Rabla komanda kopā ar Dr. Divu palīdz viņai atkal iemācīties lidot.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda vēlas izcept vi lielāko pankūku! Taču situācija kļūst sarežģīta, kad Ātrmeistars grib visu sabojāt. Kad Kamilas lidmašīna kļūst netīra, vedot mājās pīles, kucēni atrod veidu, kā nomazgāt lidmašīnu... debesīs!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Meklējot zeltu varavīksnes galā, Briežu komanda nonāk Sala kalnā un atrod jaunu draugu! Briežu komandai jātiek galā ar sarežģītām situācijām, ko rada sera Tērauda jaunākais izgudrojums - Milzu tosteris!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims izmēģina jaunus raķešzābakus, kas drīz kļūst nekontrolējami. Tims, Tomijs un Tija pieskata mēness papagaili. Tims, Tomijs un Tija sacenšas ar vecākiem astesbumbā.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Gabriels rīko Talantu šovu, taču Ātrummeistars izdomā plānu, lai viņš būtu vienīgais dalībnieks. Cetnieklīča svētkos dziedās Sjerra Spīdošā, un vajadzīgi jauni instrumenti.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Kad Deizija noskrāpē ceļgalu, mācoties braukt ar skrituļdēli, Krokodilkungs cenšas nepieļaut, ka viņa iegūst vēl kādu sāpīti. Krokodilkungs un Deizija sacenšas ar Vinstonu futbola mačā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni sagatavo izrādi Barbamammai dzimšanas dienā. Kamēr Barbalala uzkopj, viņi sodas uz lunaparku, kur Barbabo iesprūst karuselī. Trīs atsevišķi stāsti saplūst kopā pagalma vidū.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbaliba, Barbalala un Barbabella pēc kārtas stāsta stāstu. Katra iekļauj tajā ko ļoti personīgu. Barbapapu ģimene pavada dienu pludmalē. Sadalījušies 2 komandās, barbabērni cīnās par smilšu pussalu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims dara visu, lai tiktu pie jaunās Dinozvaigznes figūriņas. Ir Astro-joku diena, bet Tims nezina, kad apstāties. Timam un tētim jānoķer traucējošs kurmis.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas būt divos pasākumos reizē. Tims meklē Kajai uzkodu bez purvzāles. Pēc vairākiem zaudējumiem Tija cenšas uzvarēt visās ballīšu spēlēs.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mēre Greitveja un Dakija Dū kungs vēlas nodemonstrēt savas izpletņlēkšanas prasmes. Taču, kad patraucē vējš, suņi palīdz viņiem lēkt ar izpletni uz zemes! Kad Vīleram un cūkai Trifelei nesanāk slidot, komanda rod risinājumu uz riteņiem!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi atrod vectēva Grants laimīgi boulinga bumbu. Diemžēl Celtnieklīcī nav boulinga zāles... līdz šim! Kad pēkšņa superziedēšana sagūsta Motori, Liliju un Parka Reindžeri Rozu, suņiem jārod ziediem draudzīgs risinājums.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Kad Tedijs un Fredijs ierodas pie Deizijas spēlēties, viņi atrod viņas senu mīļāko rotaļlietu - mazu zoss figūriņu vārdā Zosīte. Redzot, cik ļoti tā patīk viņas brāļiem, viņa to viņiem uzdāvina, atzīstot, ka vairs ar to nespēlējas. Tiklīdz tā atdota, viņa sāk ilgoties pēc Zosītes, it īpaši pēc tam, kad uzzina, ka zēni nomainījuši tās vārdu uz Dino Džims. Krokodila kungs nolemj palīdzēt Deizijai atgūt savu rotaļlietu un atrast aizvietotāju, ar ko zēni varētu spēlēties, bet dvīņi vēlas Zosīti!

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Dora
